news.title: Ex-KSU student had been dead for days; roommates didn’t notice
news.summary: A Kennesaw State University student was found dead in his dorm room after his mother called in a welfare check. She had not heard from him in about 10 days.

news.title: 9 arrested in Gwinnett County for trespassing at home seen on TikTok
news.summary: Several suspects told officers they learned about the home through TikTok and went onto the property to explore or take pictures.

news.title: Viral TikTok trend leads to 5 arrests in Gwinnett County
news.summary: Five adults were arrested, and seven teens were contacted after breaking into an unoccupied home in the 3900 block of Westbrook Road in Suwanee, according to the Gwinnett County Police Department.
